summary: Iteration 13 validated the Moderator interjection endpoint (POST /api/conversations/{cid}/moderate) and the Admin Usage Report (GET /api/admin/usage-report) end-to-end. All 10 backend pytest cases passed. Frontend smoke of /team shows the new 'Laporan Pemakaian Kredit' section with all testids present (usage-range-7/30/90, usage-total, usage-top-user, usage-by-user, usage-by-feature, usage-daily), Indonesian feature labels (Panggilan Realtime, Chat, Notulen, Moderator, Suara (TTS), Potret Persona, Transkripsi (STT), Tugas Agen), and range switching re-fetches without console errors. Home loads cleanly. Realtime meeting UI launch was NOT exercised to avoid admin credit burn; backend moderator path is fully covered by tests.

issues: Within the small 7-day workspace there's no visible loading indicator when switching range (loading state only shown on first mount) – minor UX nit.

critical_code_review_comments: admin.py usage_report: by_user uses actor_id or workspace_id (owner) as fallback, so owner-attributed events show as the admin – correct, but if an event lacks created_at it would key under '' in daily (not currently observed).
chat.py moderate(): rate-limited via 'chat' bucket; good. Returns credits_used which is not in the spec but harmless.
chat.py _is_stuck uses a plain LLM YES/NO prompt — cost per call is small but could be cached; acceptable for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Transient meeting + private test conversations created and cleaned up by fixtures.
